test_title: PYST 53: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 9th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A trader sells an article for Rs. 498 after offering a discount of 17% on its marked price. Had he not offered any discount, he would have earned a profit of 25%. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the article?
solution: **Given:** SP = Rs. 498, Discount of 17% on MP. **Formula used:** MP = SP/(100 - Discount) × 100 CP = MP/(100 + profit) × 100, where SP = Selling price
